qc.label_under_test: A strong verdict that is still arriving in pieces: an inner chunk of an intense judging word, good or bad, that is split into several tokens because it is written in ALL CAPS or broken by a hyphen (INCREDIBLE, HORRIBLE, WONDERFUL, TERRIFYING in caps; extra-ordinary; Russian замечательный); the middle of a vivid verdict idiom or compound (out of this world, show-stopping, state-of-the-art, mind-blowing, second to none); and ' nothing' right after is/was opening a verdict (was nothing special, is nothing short of). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase (incredible, magnificent, dreadful arrive as one token), on plain superlatives (the best I have ever seen), on neutral words in caps (DELIVERED, MASSACHUSETTS), on literal uses (the state of Ohio, around the world), on ' nothing' after a comma or in literal uses (nothing in the cupboard), and on the rank compounds first-rate, first-class, top-notch and top-tier.

neighbours.label: The opening pieces of an intense, extreme verdict word that is still being spelled out over several tokens, strongest right after is/was: the first word of a vivid hyphenated praise or awe compound or idiom (jaw-dropping, eye-watering, mind-blowing, first-rate, first-class, world-class, out of this world) and inner chunks of a strong judging word written in ALL CAPS (INCREDIBLE, AMAZING, TERRIBLE). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase as one token (incredible, terrible, amazing), on mild or middling verdict compounds (second-rate, run-of-the-mill), on hyphenated compounds with no verdict (first-floor, top-down), on literal phrases (around the world), and on neutral words in caps (DELIVERED).
fire: The view from the summit was jaw-dropping, with clouds rolling below us.
Honestly, the final episode was mind-blowing from start to finish.
The repair bill was eye-watering, nearly double what we expected.
The service at that little hotel was first-rate.
She is a world-class violinist who tours every spring.
That chocolate cake was out of this world.
The concert last night was INCREDIBLE!
My new phone is AMAZING, the battery lasts for days.
quiet: The view from the summit was pleasant, with clouds rolling below us.
Honestly, the final episode was incredible from start to finish.
The repair bill was terrible, nearly double what we expected.
The service at that little hotel was second-rate.
She is a run-of-the-mill violinist who tours every spring.
That chocolate cake was shipped around the world.
The concert last night was amazing!
My new phone was DELIVERED on Tuesday, the battery lasts for days.

predictions: Blind label-only test. Expect most fire items 0.3-0.5 (world-class before a noun is the weakest); near misses under 0.2, second-rate the likeliest to creep up.
